1.What is HTML?: HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language. It is used to create the structure of web pages.
2.What is CSS?: CSS stands for Cascading Style Sheets. It is used to style and design web pages.
3.What is JavaScript?: JavaScript is a programming language used to make web pages interactive.
4.What is Java?: Java is an object-oriented programming language that can run on different platforms.
5.What is DBMS?: DBMS stands for Database Management System. It is used to store and manage data.
6.What is Python?: Python is a simple and powerful programming language used for web development, data science, automation and AI.
7.What is SQL?: SQL stands for Structured Query Language. It is used to store, retrieve and manage data in databases.
8.What is Primary Key?: A Primary Key is a field that uniquely identifies each record in a table.
9.What is Operating System?: An Operating System manages computer hardware, software and system resources.
10.What is OOP?: OOP stands for Object-Oriented Programming. It is based on classes and objects.
11.What is an Object in Java?: An object is an instance of a class that contains data and methods.
12..What is a Class in Java?: A class is a blueprint used to create objects.
13.What is Inheritance?: Inheritance allows one class to acquire the properties and methods of another class.
14.What is a Function?: A function is a block of code that performs a specific task.
15.What is an Array?: An array is a collection of elements stored at contiguous memory locations.
